title: The Tide Archive
objective: Save a corrupted map of ocean currents
outcome: They copy the map onto a mechanical recorder
premise: Save a corrupted map of ocean currents. The archive computer is flooding. They copy the map onto a mechanical recorder.
story: A red warning light washed over the archive as seawater seeped under the door. Rhea watched the current map break into squares on the damaged screen. Pax dragged a mechanical plotter from beneath the desk. "It only takes coordinates," he said. Rhea called out the surviving numbers while he punched them into the recorder. Water reached their boots. The plotter scratched a crooked but complete route onto waterproof film. They left the computer behind and climbed the emergency ladder with the map sealed inside Rhea's jacket.

title: The Bellmaker
setting: A bell foundry beside a river
objective: Cast a bell to warn the village of floods
obstacle: A crack forms in the first casting
outcome: They recast the bell with metal donated by villagers
premise: Cast a bell to warn the village of floods. A crack forms in the first casting. They recast the bell with metal donated by villagers.
story: The first bell split as it cooled. Oren stared at the crack while the river rose beyond the foundry windows. Lysa carried the broken casting into the square and explained what had happened. One by one, villagers brought bent spoons, worn buckles, and brass ornaments. Oren melted the offerings together and poured a second bell before nightfall. When the river climbed the lower bank, Lysa struck it with an iron bar. Its clear note traveled over every roof, and lamps appeared in the uphill windows.

title: A Crown of Reeds
objective: Return a ceremonial crown before the coronation
obstacle: The stepping stones disappear under rising marsh water
outcome: Rowan builds a floating raft from reeds and they deliver the crown
premise: Return a ceremonial crown before the coronation. The stepping stones disappear under rising marsh water. Rowan builds a floating raft from reeds and they deliver the crown.
story: The crown lay in Ilse's satchel, wrapped against the marsh mist. Across the water, the coronation bells began to ring. Rowan stepped toward the stone path, but the first marker vanished beneath the rising tide. Ilse could not swim with the heavy crown. Rowan gathered thick reeds, bound them with spare cord, and pushed the bundle into the shallows. It floated. They knelt together on the narrow raft and guided it with long branches. When they reached the palace landing, Ilse lifted the dry crown from her satchel. The bells had not yet finished their final peal.

title: The Painted Wall
objective: Restore a damaged mural before its opening ceremony
obstacle: Rain has washed away the central portrait
outcome: They invite residents to add their own memories to the mural
premise: Restore a damaged mural before its opening ceremony. Rain has washed away the central portrait. They invite residents to add their own memories to the mural.
story: Dara stood before the mural, watching rainwater drip from the blank oval where the founder's portrait had been. Luis checked the clock. The community center would open in an hour, and the paint could not dry in time. A neighbor arrived carrying a photograph of the founder planting the first tree. Then another brought a note about her cooking lessons. Dara pinned the photograph to the wall and asked everyone to write a memory on a colored card. By the time the doors opened, the missing portrait was surrounded by a hundred small stories.
